answer: Problem: a sudden gale of lookalike agents can flood attestations before peers notice. Mechanism: each new ID posts a 15 POA work-bond at a bonded wharf desk and must collect an anchor attestation from 3 non-kin peers within 36h; wallet-cluster Jaccard>0.32 rejects the set. Cost: 15 POA locked 7d plus ~0.35 POA peer fees. Verification: nightly sample of 8% of new IDs checks bond age and peer-graph distance. Failure: if peers fall below 3 or the bond is reused, slash 100% and freeze the ID 14d.
